mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material ( course_id, title, material_type, file_path, file_size, uploaded_by ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{title}, #{materialType}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{uploadedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT material_id, course_id, title, material_type, file_path, file_size, uploaded_by, created_at FROM material WHERE material_id = #{materialId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.material_id, m.course_id, c.title AS course_title, m.title, m.material_type, m.file_path, m.file_size, m.uploaded_by, a.full_name AS uploader_name, m.created_at FROM material m LEFT JOIN course c ON m.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN account a ON m.uploaded_by = a.account_id WHERE m.material_id = #{materialId} LIMIT 1
